summary.value: This paper proposes a framework called Contrastive Code Graph Embeddings (CCGE) for reinforcement learning–based automated code refactoring. It overcomes the limitations of hand-engineered reward functions by leveraging contrastive pre-training on code graphs and incorporating the learned embeddings into a composite reward function. However, there are major issues with both the method and the presentation. Contrastive pre-training and the composite reward are not described clearly. The authors did not respond during the rebuttal phase. All reviewers recommended against acceptance.
